name: Solfa
author: SirAllap
description: Solfa — YouTube Music in the bar and a keyboard panel. Search, play, queue, library, lyrics and likes; the web app runs hidden as the engine and never takes focus.

barWidget.description: Now playing with a round cover, quick controls, and a panel for search, queue, library and lyrics

schema.label: Previous, play/pause and next in the bar
Show in the bar when nothing is loaded
Shortcuts: Super+M panel, Super+Alt+M play/pause, Super+Alt+N next, Super+Alt+B previous, Super+Alt+L like (only keys nobody else uses)
Start YouTube Music with the shell
Browser for the engine
schema.description: An absolute path to a Chromium-family browser executable, e.g. /usr/bin/brave. Empty: the first found of chromium, google-chrome-stable, brave, brave-browser, vivaldi-stable, microsoft-edge-stable.

schema.label: Equalizer preset
schema.description: flat, bass, treble, vocal, loudness or custom.

schema.label: Equalizer band gains, dB (JSON array, 10 bands 32 Hz-16 kHz)
When Solfa starts, resume paused instead of playing
Volume when Solfa starts
schema.description: "last" (the volume it had) or a 0-100 percent.

schema.label: Refresh the page past this JS heap (MB)
Refresh the page at least every (hours)
